items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: I didn’t make — there was no distinction really. ... Ellington — I’d take a medley of all his stuff which he always does on his concerts... Incidentally I saw them once, I think it was at Monterey.

ctx.x: No — Duke Ellington, Count Basie, Benny Goodman, Artie Shaw. I didn’t make — there was no distinction really. And I don’t think the people in my group gave any real thought to the fact that a white band would take on a black player or vice versa. Much more likely than a black band taking on a white player by the way, but I didn’t sense any of what I feel now out there, that there’s some strife brewing that some people — who shall remain unnamed — say that there are no whites who know how to play jazz. Well that’s…
